EXT.evidence: Offers reassurance in a brief exchange but shows no clear outgoing, energetic, or highly talkative behavior; even defers to another with “…Pheebs?”

AGR.evidence: Expresses empathy and support—says the other isn’t alone in feeling uncertain, includes herself and another, and reassures that everything will come together and be “un-floopy.”

CON.evidence: Gives general reassurance but shows no behaviors indicating organization, planning, or task efficiency.

NEU.evidence: Speaks calmly and optimistically, predicting things will come together and become “un-floopy,” showing confidence rather than anxiety.

OPN.evidence: Displays flexibility and creativity by coining “un-floopy” and normalizing uncertainty rather than taking a rigid stance.
